name: firmware-purple-team
description: Barzakh purple-team validation loop for UEFI bootkit detection: generate a paired malicious/clean test corpus, validate detector coverage against it (gaps are reported in the results), list the bundled multi-stage scenario chains, run a chain end-to-end against the detector suite, and enumerate the built-in detectors for coverage-gap triage. A chain that is not fully detected (adversary exit code 1) is surfaced as a result, not an error.

vars.name: corpus_dir
vars.description: Corpus directory generated by barzakh_corpus and validated by barzakh_validate

vars.name: chain
vars.description: Scenario chain to run (one of blacklotus-chain, dma-preboot-chain, mobile-bootchain, nvram-downgrade-chain, rustkit-ffi-chain, smm-persistence-chain)
